v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Véniet Dóminus, * et non tardábit, et illuminábit abscóndita tenebrárum, et manifestábit se ad omnes gentes, allelúia.
text.en: The Lord will come, * and will not tarry; He both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make Himself manifest to all people. Alleluia.

text.la: Ierúsalem, gaude * gáudio magno, quia véniet tibi Salvátor, allelúia.
text.en: Rejoice greatly, O Jerusalem, * for thy Saviour cometh unto thee. Alleluia.

text.la: Dabo in Sion * salútem, et in Ierúsalem glóriam meam, allelúia.
text.en: I will place salvation in Zion, * and My glory in Jerusalem. Alleluia.

text.la: Fratres: Gaudéte in Dómino semper: íterum dico, gaudéte. Modéstia vestra nota sit ómnibus homínibus: Dóminus enim prope est.
text.en: Brothers: Rejoice in the Lord always; again, I say, rejoice. Let your modesty be known to all men. The Lord is nigh.

v.la: Roráte, cæli, désuper, et nubes pluant iustum.
v.en: Drop down dew, ye heavens, from above, and let the clouds rain the Just.

r.en: Let the earth be opened, and bud forth the Saviour.

text.la: Ante me * non est formátus Deus, et post me non erit: quia mihi curvábitur omne genu, et confitébitur omnis lingua.
text.en: Before Me * there was no god formed, neither shall there be after Me; for unto Me every knee shall bow, and every tongue shall swear.

text.la: Aurem tuam, quǽsumus, Dómine, précibus nostris accómmoda: et mentis nostræ ténebras, grátia tuæ visitatiónis illústra:
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee, mercifully incline thine ears unto our prayers, and lighten the darkness of our minds by the grace of thy heavenly visitation.
